overtimeSheets.description: Upload a spreadsheet to add overtime entries to employee monthly sheets. Valid rows are added to DRAFT or RETURNED sheets (created if needed). Sheets are not auto-submitted.
overtimeSheets.requiredColumns: Required: employeeEmail or employeeId, year, month, date, startTime, endTime, taskDescription. Optional: isHoliday.

overtimeEntries.title: Import sheet entries
overtimeEntries.description: Upload a spreadsheet to add entries to this overtime sheet. The sheet must be DRAFT or RETURNED. Dates must fall in the sheet month.
overtimeEntries.requiredColumns: Required: date, startTime, endTime, taskDescription. Optional: isHoliday.

expenseClaims.title: Import expense claim items
expenseClaims.description: Upload a spreadsheet to add line items to employee DRAFT claims. Claims are created by employee + title when needed. Receipts are not imported - upload them before submit. Claims are not auto-submitted.
expenseClaims.requiredColumns: Required: employeeEmail or employeeId, title, category, description, expenseDate, amount, currency. Optional: claimDescription.

expenseClaimItems.title: Import claim items
expenseClaimItems.description: Upload a spreadsheet to add line items to this DRAFT expense claim. Receipts must be uploaded in the UI before submit.
expenseClaimItems.requiredColumns: Required: category, description, expenseDate, amount, currency.

flightApplications.title: Import flight passengers
flightApplications.description: Upload a spreadsheet to add passengers to employee DRAFT flight applications. Applications are created by submitter + trip when needed. Tickets are not imported. Applications are not auto-submitted.
flightApplications.requiredColumns: Required: submitterEmail or submitterId, tripType, isInternational, originCountry, originCity, destination, departureDate, purpose, ticketClass, passengerEmail or passengerId. Optional: returnDate, accommodation*, perDiemRequired, notes, passportNumber, visaRequired, visaStatus.

flightPassengers.title: Import passengers
flightPassengers.description: Upload a spreadsheet to add passengers to this DRAFT flight application. Tickets are attached in the UI after approval.
flightPassengers.requiredColumns: Required: passengerEmail or passengerId. Optional: passportNumber, visaRequired, visaStatus.

businessTrips.title: Import business trip passengers
businessTrips.description: Upload a spreadsheet to add passengers to employee DRAFT business trips. Trips are created by submitter + route when needed. Tickets are not imported. Trips are not auto-submitted.
businessTrips.requiredColumns: Required: submitterEmail or submitterId, tripType, originCountry, originCity, destinationCountry, destinationCity, departureDate, purpose, ticketClass, passengerEmail or passengerId. Optional: returnDate, host*, costs, accommodation*, perDiemRequired, notes, passportNumber, visaRequired, visaStatus.

businessTripPassengers.title: Import passengers
businessTripPassengers.description: Upload a spreadsheet to add passengers to this DRAFT business trip. Tickets are attached in the UI after approval.
businessTripPassengers.requiredColumns: Required: passengerEmail or passengerId. Optional: passportNumber, visaRequired, visaStatus.

perDiemRequests.title: Import per diem requests
perDiemRequests.description: Upload a spreadsheet to submit per diem requests on behalf of employees. Valid rows enter the approval workflow. Rates and totals are calculated from each employee's active destination rates.
perDiemRequests.requiredColumns: Required: employeeEmail or employeeId, destinationCategory, destination, startDate, endDate. Optional: notes, linkedFlightId, linkedBusinessTripId.

purchaseRequests.title: Import purchase request items
purchaseRequests.description: Upload a spreadsheet to add line items to employee DRAFT purchase requests. Requests are created by employee + title when needed. Item images are not imported. Requests are not auto-submitted.
purchaseRequests.requiredColumns: Required: employeeEmail or employeeId, title, justification, itemName, quantity, unit, unitPrice, currency. Optional: vendorName, vendorContact, requiredByDate, projectId, projectCode, modelSpec, description.

purchaseRequestItems.title: Import request items
purchaseRequestItems.description: Upload a spreadsheet to add line items to this DRAFT or RETURNED purchase request. Item images must be uploaded in the UI.
purchaseRequestItems.requiredColumns: Required: itemName, quantity, unit, unitPrice, currency. Optional: modelSpec, description.

materialRequisitions.title: Import material requisition items
materialRequisitions.description: Upload a spreadsheet to add line items to employee DRAFT material requisitions. Requisitions are created by employee + title when needed. Requisitions are not auto-submitted.
materialRequisitions.requiredColumns: Required: employeeEmail or employeeId, title, purpose, itemName, quantity, unit. Optional: warehouseLocation, requiredByDate, projectId, projectCode, itemCode, description.

materialRequisitionItems.title: Import requisition items
materialRequisitionItems.description: Upload a spreadsheet to add line items to this DRAFT or RETURNED material requisition.
materialRequisitionItems.requiredColumns: Required: itemName, quantity, unit. Optional: itemCode, description.

consumablesRequisitions.title: Import consumables requisition items
consumablesRequisitions.description: Upload a spreadsheet to add line items to employee DRAFT consumables requisitions. Requisitions are created by employee + title when needed (max 20 items each). Requisitions are not auto-submitted.
consumablesRequisitions.requiredColumns: Required: employeeEmail or employeeId, title, purpose, itemName, quantity, unit. Optional: department, requiredByDate, itemCode, modelSpec, description, unitPrice.

consumablesRequisitionItems.title: Import requisition items
consumablesRequisitionItems.description: Upload a spreadsheet to add line items to this DRAFT or RETURNED consumables requisition (max 20 items).
consumablesRequisitionItems.requiredColumns: Required: itemName, quantity, unit. Optional: itemCode, modelSpec, description, unitPrice.
